name: Agent Evals tab lists the seeded cases and the latest run metrics
description: From /agents, open the seeded Security Reviewer and switch to ?tab=evals. The seed gives it 9 eval cases (5 must find, 4 must not flag), so at least 8 case rows render with both kind badges. In fixture mode the seed also stores two finished suite runs; the metric strip shows the latest (v2): recall 80% (4/5), precision 67% (4/6), citation accuracy 100%, cases passed 6/9. The dashboard link is present. Read-only: never clicks the run button (eval-run-button), so no model call. Needs the API started with PROJECT_DOCS_SOURCE=fixture (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: open the Evals tab via the deep link
evals tab is active in the URL
at least 8 seeded eval cases are listed
a 'must find' kind badge is shown
a 'must not flag' kind badge is shown
